\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; OVERVIEW\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 58 year old male patient came to casualty with chief complaints of:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;lower abdominal pain: 1 week ,burning micturation:1week ,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Elow back ache after lifting weights\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Edribbling \/ decrease of urine out put:1week\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Efever :1 week\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESOB :1week \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; Appraisal :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECase history was taken well and examination was very well done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Negative points :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt would be better if fever chart is added as it was treated with strict temp monitoring as it would be better understood improvement of the case was not well mentioned\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; My analysis :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;This is a case of Acute kidney injury( AKI) 2° to UTI, associated with Denovo - DM -2\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWith ? Right HEART FAILURE,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWith K\/C\/O - HTN ( Not on Rx)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-AKI causes a build-up of waste products in your blood and makes it hard for your kidneys to keep the right balance of fluid in your bodyand return of creatinine to the base line and symptoms less then 3 months indicating it to be a AKI\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAcute on ckd :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttp:\/\/srinaini25.blogspot.com\/2021\/07\/srinaini-roll-no-33-3rd-semester-this.html\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; Overview :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 75yr old male patient ,labourer by occupation ,came to casuality with Cheif complaints of\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E• Lower backache since 10days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E• dribbling of urine since 10days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E• Pedal edema since 3days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E• SOB at rest since 3days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E• Increased involuntary movements of both upper limbs since 10days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Appraisal :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory was taken well\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENegative points :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere are no pictures of pedal edema .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EProper chronological order of symptoms apperance was not done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo IO charting was done though it was told it should be strictly monitored\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;My analysis:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is case of Acute renal failure (intrinsic)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGrade 1 L4-L5 Spondylodiscitis, Multifocal infectious Spondylodiscitis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHyperuricemia 2° to Renal failure\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUraemia induced tremors( resolved)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDelirium 2° to septic \/Uremic encephalopathy (resolving)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECKD:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/krupalatha54.blogspot.com\/2021\/07\/a-49-yr-old-female-with-generalized.html?m=1\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Overview :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 49 yr old female , mother of 2 children, who is a house wife, apparently asymptomatic 13 yrs ago and then she noticed mass per anum with bleeding , went to hospital and diagnosed as haemorrhoids and got operated.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Since 3 yrs she has history of muscle aches, for which she is using NSAIDs.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- She has h\/o fever 20 days back, got treated in the local hospital, and\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Since 20 days she has generalized weakness.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- She also has h\/o vomitings since 3 days, with food as content, non - projectile , non bilious.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Apprisal:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory was taken well.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGood lab work clear evaluation was done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENegative points :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere are no clinical pics of the symptoms\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EProper chronological order of symptoms apperance was not done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFever chart was not included.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo IO charting was done though it was told it should be strictly monitoredit would have been better if urine was sent for eosinophils for interatial disease\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; My analysis:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is case of CKD ?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Chronic interstitial nephritis secondary to plasma cell dyscariasis, (multiple myeloma - 70% plasmacytosis).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPATIENT WITH COMA AND RENAL FAILURE :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/ananyapulikandala106.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/a-35yr-old-female-elog.html\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOverview :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 35 yr old female with Fever and Diarrhea since 5 days( 4 to 5 times a day with blood discharge).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBack pain( 5 days ago) with abdominal pain and chest pain.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppraisal:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWith good fever charting with all the necessary information.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory was taken detailed way\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAll the tests were properly done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENegative points :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI could not find the negative data in the elog \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;My analysis :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt could be the hypoxia which could have caused the permanent brain damage which was the reason for her vegetative state . Subjectively she was told better but objectively no improvement was Seen. Hospitalisation has increased the infection to the bed sore it would have been better if discharged early as it was permanent damage and was impossible to treat anyway.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQ4: Testing scholarship competency of the examinees ( ability to read comprehend, analyze, reflect upon and discuss captured patient centered data as in their 'original' answers to the assignment for May 2021):\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPlease analyze the above linked patient data by first preparing a problem list for each patient (based on the shared data) and then discuss the diagnostic and therapeutic uncertainty around solving those problems. Also include the review of literature around sensitivity and specificity of the diagnostic interventions mentioned and same around efficacy of the therapeutic interventions mentioned for each patient.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnalysis of \u0026nbsp;the data\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;https:\/\/ananyapulikandala106.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/a-35yr-old-female-elog.html\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnalysis of A 35 yr old female with Fever and Diarrhea since 5 days( 4 to 5 times a day with blood discharge).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBack pain( 5 days ago) with abdominal pain and chest pain\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVegetative state of the patient could be due to hypoxia which could have caused the permanent brain damage which was the reason for her vegetative state . Subjectively she was told better but objectively no improvement was Seen.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELink supporting the data\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIntermittent Fever spikes can be explained due to the bed sores clearly explained through culture of the sores\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESepsis might be the reason for encephalopathy by altering the blood brain barrier\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.hindawi.com\/journals\/amed\/2014\/762320\/\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQ 5) Testing scholarship competency in \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Elogging reflective observations on your concrete experiences of this last month : (10 marks)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReflective logging of one's own experiences is a vital tool toward competency development in medical education and research.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe telemedical learning from the hospital has been a new experience and we learnt quite lot of things through reflective observation during lockdown. it's a bit challenging as we have just entered internship ,We have learnt elogging of the cases in a very short span of time and made juniors do so. \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Question 1: Competency tested for Peer to peer review and assessment :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHere are my qualitative insights into what was good or bad about the answer.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3.Cause for current acute excerbation ?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eit could be due any infection\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn my opinion it could be due to allergy ie hypersensitivity due to weather conditions in January ... As patient has repeated episodes of symptoms at the same time every year..\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQ 2) Share the link to your own case report of a patient that you connected with and engaged while capturing his her sequential life events before and after the illness and clinical and investigational images along with your discussion of that case.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/nikithaedam48.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/18-year-old-malefrom-miryalagudawho-is.html?m=1\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/nikithaedam48.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/18-year-old-malefrom-miryalagudawho-is.html?m=1\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Q3)Testing peer review competency of the examinees) :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPlease go through the cases in the links shared above and provide your critical appraisal of the captured data in terms of completeness, correctness and ability to provide useful leads to analyze the diagnostic and therapeutic uncertainties around the cases share\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQ 4)Please analyze the above linked patient data by first preparing a problem list for each patient (based on the shared data) and then discuss the diagnostic and therapeutic uncertainty around solving those problems. Also include the review of literature around sensitivity and specificity of the diagnostic interventions mentioned and same around efficacy of the therapeutic interventions mentioned for each patient.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMULTI SYSTEM\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/nikithaedam48.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/18-year-old-malefrom-miryalagudawho-is.html?m=1\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Overview\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E18 year old male came with the chief complaints of back pain since 1 week ,low backache 1 week ago,fever since 5 days ,yellowish discolouration of eyes since 3 days ,vomitings (2 episodes) and loose stools(3 episodes)and blood tinged urine yesterday morning\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Appraisal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EExamination was very well done from \u0026nbsp;head to toe and Temperature charting with the complete information was good\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;My analysis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn my analysis as the patient has got covid antibodies positive it could me multi system inflammation - covid\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs he has Diabetes . Whole time it was seen as DKA and infection rather than MIS-C\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECNS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/pallavi191.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/gm-cases.html?m=1\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Overview\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 28 year old male came with history of TB 1 month back came with \u0026nbsp;chief complaints of sudden fall followed by weakness of both the lower limbs (paraplegia) and loss of hand grip 10 days back, associated with bowel and bladder incontinence.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Appraisal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe fact that the patients relative was also infected with TB solidifies the diagnosis.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe approach to the cause of the paralysis through a detailed history of case was done well\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Negative points\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Tuberculosis affecting the nerve root through a cold abscess can be clinically found by examination rather than going through an advanced techniques like CT\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe history was inadequate about the abscess\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; My analysis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;The \u0026nbsp;spine will be secondarily affected in the TB..\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EProper examination for the local deficits of the involved region ... Is need\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf it is just due to compression of cold abscess will the draining of abscess helps him to continue his normal life\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERenal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/61tejarshini.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/general-medicine-case-discussion.html?m=1\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECaptured by one student from 2017 batch in the link below\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Overview\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; A 45 yr old male with cheif complaints of : Altered Sensorium (Hypo active) and lethargy since \u0026nbsp;Morning\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of fever 10 days back,lasted for 3 days, followed by Pedal edema with Anasarca with Shortness of breath present even at rest .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppraisal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWell monitoring of \u0026nbsp;creatinine and halting the damage to kidney without going to irreversible failure.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAlso dialysis which helped the patient's encephalopathy was good .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECase was taken correctly including all systems . All the problems like infection, hypertension and chronic proteinuria causing kidney failure were addressed well and treated\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENegative points\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history about addiction was not taken properly which might help diagnosis and liver cirrhosis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was not warned or given medication for hypertension or pedal edema which might be first sign of renal failure\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe liver failure was not explained which had lead to cirrhosis , damage to liver was not know as LFT was not done\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy analysis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI think case history was taken incompletely and it would be better if LFT was taken .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt's better to prevent disease than cure so proper management of initial \u0026nbsp;symptoms like pedal edema or hypertension should be properly done and review examination should be done frequently\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECVS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr occupation came to the casualty with the \u0026nbsp;chief complaints of-\u003Cdiv\u003E•fever since 1 month\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E•facial puffiness since 9 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E•decreased urine output since 6 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E•vomiting since 2-3 days\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHOPI–\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic one month back and then developed fever,Which was high-grade, associated with chills, and was taken to a local hospital and \u0026nbsp;got treated. Along with fever, she had loss of appetite and loss of taste. Fever subsided for one day and then she developed it again.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe visited the hospital after 15 days, Where they advised her to consult a gynaecologist as she had her last LMP2 years back\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe never had any complaints of pain abdomen\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThen, she consulted a gynaecologist, and the doctor advised her USG for the localisation of infection. The USG revealed a right ovarian cyst. Along with USG ,haemogram, RFT, LFT were done. RFT showed all \u0026nbsp;the values Within the normal range with creatinine being around 0.9-1 ,Haemoglobin was normal. Apart from having right ovarian cyst, she has no other findings. So, the patient was referred to a general surgeon. The size of the variant cyst was about 8 cm and the doctors thought to operate it. They scheduled the surgery on 11\/7\/21 and \u0026nbsp;patient had been to the hospital on 9\/7\/21 For pre-anaesthetic checkup. So, on that day her HB was 10, and then she underwent two units of PRBC transfusion. The patient was scheduled to get operated on 11\/7\/21 at 3:00 pm. When the patient was in the OT and put on foley’s And all the anaesthetic medications were given but on opening the abdomen, she had subcutaneous edema and And the fluid Was gushing out of it. The doctors were not sure where the fluid was coming from, whether it’s from the right ovarian cyst or peritoneum.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAssuming it to be the peritoneal fluid, it was thought to be ascites,And ascitic fluid analysis was sent\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"454\" data-original-width=\"680\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEjDuUOUGZA_W_VRI2l8s98NwvXLG5VmxuhDE-x5jE0k7Y362Izyr4AOcHzu79-sdg9wTdGkExgtMEKyWWdGM7DTvXYONO1VSFeeOKESpbKg1vLLMepaJMeiGClsY-RPldf6v7HH3n3Wso0\/s320\/b3cfbc61-13ee-485a-9b23-04c8d3480824.jpg\" width=\"320\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThey advised to talk to oncosurgeon, who advised CECT for her to look for any cervical lymphadenopathy but it turned out to be clueless\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECAUSE OF AKI?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPerioperative AKI does not arise from a single insult, but instead develops as a result of several, with hypoperfusion and inflammation thought to be the main drivers.[1] Perioperative AKI is due to inflammation caused by hemodynamic instabilities, nephrotoxicity, damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP), and obstruction.[3] Decrease in mean arterial pressure (MAP) due to hypovolemia or systemic effects of anesthetics contribute to renal hypoperfusion. Once the intrinsic compensatory mechanisms of the kidneys, mediated through sympathetic nervous system activation leading to the production of antidiuretic hormone and angiotensin-II, are surpassed, the kidneys are unable to maintain an adequate glomerular filtration rate (GFR) and renal function is reduced. In patients with underlying chronic renal disease, autoregulation is impaired, exacerbating the effects of hypoperfusion. Additionally, surgical stimulation induces systemic inflammation leading to microcirculatory effects, endothelial dysfunction, and increased leukocyte migration. The net result of these inflammatory changes is damage to the renal tubules and AKI.[1]\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/books\/NBK557677\/\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECAUSE OF ASCITES?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFURTHER PLAN\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EINVESTIGATIONS-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhy-j0kVAbxaXnI00ySH0-DURSXxbPqBYT3a0MU1K1n3L5JRezfbUclqYe6C3a1iCFp_V9LX-tfh-TKor3xQ1CCM7iIGHz5oGuZca8ISAD3MydglFyQZYqs0aL6Zetq0nx_oNEo4dujgLI\/s834\/IMG_3935.HEIC\" style=\"margin-left: 1em;
